description: This file defines a React-like component (using Qwik framework) for a modal dialog to post a new job listing. It manages form state, validation, and submission logic for a job posting form with fields like title, company, location, type, and description.

methods.name: resetAndClose
methods.description: Resets form fields and error state, then calls onClose$ to close the modal.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Validates form fields, submits the data via onSubmit$, optionally calls onAfterSubmit$, then resets and closes the modal.
